tagline.en: OpenAI's Sora video model, accessed as a hosted API — text-to-video and image-to-video through your own provider key.
tagline.zh: OpenAI 的 Sora 视频模型，以托管 API 方式接入——通过你自己的服务商密钥使用文生视频与图生视频。

en: Sora2 is OpenAI's high-fidelity video generation model, offered here as a hosted API rather than local weights. It generates video from a text prompt and can also drive generation from an input image.
Because it runs as a service, there is nothing to download and no GPU to provision — you call it through the Studio pipeline and the provider does the compute. You supply your own API key.
In WorldFoundry, Sora2 slots into the hosted-API path: configure your key, send a prompt (and optionally an image), and receive a generated clip back from the service.
zh: Sora2 是 OpenAI 高保真的视频生成模型，这里以托管 API 而非本地权重的形式提供。它可以根据文字提示词生成视频，也能以输入图片驱动生成。
由于以服务方式运行，无需下载任何权重、也不必准备 GPU——你通过 Studio pipeline 调用，算力由服务商承担。需自备 API key。
在 WorldFoundry 中，Sora2 接入托管 API 路径：配置好密钥，发送提示词（可选附带一张图），即可从服务端取回生成的视频。

whenToUse.en: When you want top-tier video generation without managing local hardware, and you already have (or can obtain) a provider API key.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想获得顶级视频生成效果、又不想维护本地硬件，且已拥有（或能申请到）服务商 API key 时。

notFor.en: Offline or fully self-hosted workflows — it requires your own API key and network access, and output quality, availability, and cost all depend on the provider.
notFor.zh: 不适合离线或完全自托管的流程——它需要你自备 API key 和网络访问，且输出质量、可用性与成本都取决于服务商。

en: Hosted API — no local weights or GPU required
Bring your own provider API key
zh: 托管 API——无需本地权重或 GPU
支持文生视频与图生视频
需自备服务商 API key
